local ffi = require('ffi')
ffi.cdef[[uint32_t GetModuleFileNameW(void *module, uint16_t *path, uint32_t capacity);]]
local path = ffi.new('uint16_t[32768]')
local length = ffi.load('kernel32').GetModuleFileNameW(nil, path, 32768)
assert(length > 0 and length < 32768)
BingusRuntime = {hashes = {['sha256:' .. ffi.string(path, length * 2)] = os.getenv('HSU_EXE_SHA')}}
environment_shim.why: Wine bcrypt faults in BCryptDestroyHash; the one module_hash of luajit.exe is served from the runtime cache seeded with the SHA-256 computed by Python (identical for port and upstream)
